Answer: C
Reason: Comparing the initial chest X-ray (Figure 1a), which shows a homogeneous opacity in the right middle lobe, with the follow-up image (Figure 4), there is clear progression of the right-sided opacity and the appearance of new opacities in the left lung. This radiographic worsening despite antibiotic therapy indicates disease progression rather than resolution or stability.
